source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of software development tools (PDF 28).

blocks.text: Software development tools software applications banane, test karne aur sambhalne ke liye zaroori hain. Yeh developers ko code likhne, ghaltiyan dhoond kar theek karne aur software projects moassar tareeqe se chalane mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Software development tools ki ahmiyat par baat kijiye (long question 6).
blocks.explanation: Editors highlighting jaisi features se code likhna tez karte hain; translators (interpreters aur compilers) code ko aisa banate hain jo computer chala sake; debuggers theek theek batate hain ke ghalti kahan hai; IDEs in sab ko ek jagah jorte hain; repositories tabdeeliyon ki tareekh rakhti hain ta ke team ek project par mehfooz tareeqe se kaam kare. Misalein: VS Code, Python interpreter, GCC, GDB, PyCharm, GitHub. Mil kar yeh development tez aur zyada durust banate hain.

items: Development tools code likhne, test, debug aur sambhalne mein madad dete hain; aage: editors, translators, compilers, debuggers, IDEs, platforms, repositories.
